visual_anomalies.visual_description: A chaotic cluster of open voids at the Start (Left). The metal appears to have failed to wet properly, leaving a sponge-like texture.
A distinct, deep cavity visible at the End (Right) termination point.
Large, flat, rust-brown islands of silica slag adhered along the centerline. They are distinct and prominent against the grey weld metal.

surface_state.spatter_distribution: Fine granular spatter on base metal
surface_state.discoloration: Metallic grey with distinct brown patches
